admission_and_gp_details.gp_details: Dr L. Marsh, Fleet Road Surgery

diagnosis_at_discharge: Left displaced intracapsular fractured neck of femur. PMH: osteoporosis, hypertension, mild cognitive impairment.
operations_and_procedures: Left cemented hemiarthroplasty (15/07/2026) under spinal anaesthetic, uncomplicated.
reason_for_admission_and_presenting_comp: Found on the floor at home by carer after a mechanical fall, unable to weight-bear on the left leg; leg shortened and externally rotated. No head injury, no loss of consciousness.
clinical_narrative: 79F with osteoporosis and mild cognitive impairment sustained a mechanical fall at home; radiographs confirmed a displaced left intracapsular NOF fracture. Admitted under the orthogeriatric joint-care pathway and underwent left cemented hemiarthroplasty within 36 hours, per NICE hip fracture standards. Post-operative course satisfactory, mobilised with physiotherapy from day 1, progressing from frame to elbow crutches. Wound healing well with staples in situ. Bone health assessed, bisphosphonate/vitamin D started. Cognition mildly abnormal but unchanged from baseline per family; no delirium.
relevant_investigations_and_results: Hb 108 (transfused 1U). Bone profile: Ca 2.28, vit D 32 (low). X-ray: satisfactory hemiarthroplasty position.
discharge_destination: Community rehabilitation bed (Fleet Grange) for ongoing physiotherapy before planned return home.
relevant_legal_information: Mild cognitive impairment but retained capacity to consent to surgery/discharge planning; no DoLS or IMCA required. Family involved with patient's agreement.
information_given_to_patient_or_represen: Fracture, surgery and rehabilitation plan discussed with patient and son. Both counselled on hip precautions, falls-prevention at home, and bone-health medication compliance. Advised to seek urgent review for worsening pain, wound issues, fevers or new inability to weight-bear.

physical.at_discharge: Mobilising with elbow crutches/frame, physio ongoing

other.at_discharge: Wound healing well, staples in situ for removal

advice_recommendations_and_future_plans.gp_actions: Arrange staple removal by 27/07/2026 if not done at rehab unit.
advice_recommendations_and_future_plans.advice_and_recommendations: For GP: continue bone protection (alendronic acid + AdCal D3) long-term; arrange DEXA if not already booked; falls clinic referral made. Counselling given as above re hip precautions, falls prevention and bone-health medication compliance.
advice_recommendations_and_future_plans.strategies_for_potential_problems: Family/rehab staff aware of falls and cognitive history; escalation plan discussed with son.

hospital.action: Orthopaedic OP follow-up in 6 weeks with hip X-ray; Fracture Liaison Service follow-up for osteoporosis.

community_and_specialist_services.action: Rehab unit physiotherapy/OT; staple removal; falls referral.

medications_stopped_or_changed.details: Amlodipine dose reduced (postural hypotension). Co-codamol changed to paracetamol+short course oxycodone post-op, to be weaned.
